title: American Mattress Manufacturing Recalls Renovated Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,500.

title: Enesco Recalls Shelly's Diner Collectible Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The diner's power adapter can overheat and melt the adapter's plastic housing, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: Mattresses Recalled by Easy-Rest Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,800.

title: City Versa Strollers Recalled by Baby Jogger Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stroller frame can fail to lock in place and collapse while in use, posing a fall hazard to children in the stroller. Units: About 8,400 in the United States and 2,200 in Canada.

title: Fu San Machinery Recalls Low Lead Ball Valves Installed in Flammable Gas Lines Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The valves can crack and cause gas to leak. This poses fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 163,000.

title: Wing Enterprises Recalls Switch-it Stepladder/Stepstools Due to Fall Hazard; Sold exclusively at Home Depot
summary: When extended, the inner side rails can separate from the outer side rails causing the user to fall. Units: About 20,000.

title: High-Powered Magnet Sets Recalled by Reiss Innovations Due to Ingestion Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: When two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About 500.

title: Cybex International Recalls Leg Press Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The weight platform locking mechanism can fail and the backrest can disengage during normal use, posing a risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 430.

title: Dream On Me Recalls Bath Seats Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The bath seats fail to meet federal safety standards, including the requirements for stability. Specifically, the bath seats can tip over, posing a risk of drowning to babies. Units: About 50,000.

title: Dream On Me Recalls Children's Bed Rails Due to Suffocation and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The bed rail can separate from the mattress allowing a child's body to become entrapped if it slips between the rail and the mattress. This poses suffocation and strangulation hazards to children. Units: About 900.

title: Grandin Road Recalls Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs' back legs can bend when a seated person leans back. This poses fall and injury hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,200.

title: Ridgid Pneumatic Nailers Recalled by One World Technologies Due to Laceration or Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at the Home Depot
summary: The trigger assembly on the nailers can malfunction and involuntarily discharge a fastener, posing a laceration or injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,400 Coil Roofing Nailers and 4,400 Clipped Head Framing Nailers.

title: Gas Fireplace Inserts Recalled by Jotul North America Due to Electrical Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The fireplace insert's electrical wiring can come into contact with the metal rating plate on the insert, posing electrical shock and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 1,200 in the United States and 50 in Canada.

title: Home Depot Recalls Homer's All-Purpose Bucket Mug Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The silver-colored simulated bucket handle below the rim can spark when used in a microwave oven, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,700.

title: Four Retailers Agree to Stop Sale and Voluntarily Recall Nap Nanny Recliners Due to Five Infant Deaths
summary: CPSC is warning parents and caregivers that these baby recliners contain defects in the design, warnings and instructions, which pose a substantial risk of injury and death to infants. Units: About 155,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Falls Creek Kids Denim Jeans Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snap on the front of the infant and toddler denim jeans may come loose and separate from the fabric, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 140,500.

title: American Honda Expands Recall of FourTrax ATVs Due to Crash Hazard
summary: A weld on the ATV's front right and left upper suspension arms can separate, causing the driver to lose control of the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 19,500 (about 2,900 were recalled in February 2012).

title: Bethlehem Lights Recalls Christmas Trees Sold Exclusively by QVC Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The Christmas tree base can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 15,500.

title: Muddy Outdoors Recalls Climbing Sticks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death
summary: The climbing sticks can break, posing risk of serious injury or death to users. Units: About 1,500.

title: PAPYRUS Signature Collection Frames Recalled Due to Risk of Exposure to Mold
summary: The presence of Aspergillus mold spores were discovered on the products, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems or who have impaired immune systems. Units: About 105 in the U.S. and about 3 in Canada.

title: PAPYRUS Signature Collection Ornaments Recalled Due to Risk of Exposure to Mold
summary: The presence of Aspergillus mold spores were discovered on the products, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems or who have impaired immune systems. Units: About 45,500 in the U.S. and about 10,200 in Canada.

title: PAPYRUS Signature Collection Red 17-Inch Decorative Trees Recalled Due to Risk of Exposure to Mold
summary: The presence of Aspergillus mold spores were discovered on the products, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems or who have impaired immune systems. Units: About 455 in the U.S. and about 75 in Canada.

title: Sassy and Carter's-branded Hug N’ Tug Baby Toys Recalled Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The beads inside the clear plastic sphere at the center of the toys can be released and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 45,300.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Bearcat Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,900.

title: Canon Recalls for Repair Wireless File Transmitter Due to Risk of Allergic Reaction
summary: A chemical used in the rubber part on the top cover of the product can result in a reaction that changes the rubber from black to white and poses a risk of skin irritation to the consumer. Units: About 500.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Wilier Triestina Due to Fall Hazard; Bicycle Fork's Steerer Tube Can Break
summary: The bicycle fork's steerer tube can break while in use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Catalina Outdoor Fireplace Recalled by Christmas Tree Shops Due to Burn and Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass components of the Catalina Outdoor Fireplace can break when a fire is lit posing a burn and laceration hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: LG Recalls Top-Loading Washing Machines Due to Risk of Injury
summary: An unbalanced load can cause the washing machine to shake excessively and the drum to come loose during use, posing a risk of injury to consumers and property damage to the surrounding area. Units: About 457,000.

title: Norco Recalls Havoc Bicycles Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The bicycle frame can crack at the joint where the top tube meets the down tube. A cracked tube can separate and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury or death. Units: About 90.

title: Polaris Recalls Pro-RMK Snowmobiles Due to Injury, Death Hazard
summary: The bolt attaching the front, lower left shock can fail and cause the operator to lose control of the vehicle. This poses a serious hazard of injury or death. Units: About 82.

title: Dunecraft Recalls Water Balz, Skulls, Orbs and Flower Toys Due to Serious Ingestion Hazard
summary: When the marble-sized toy is ingested, it expands inside the body and causes a blockage in the small intestine, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and could be life threatening. The toys do not show up on an x-ray and require surgery to be removed from the body. Units: About 94,70
